answers.core: This is about improving performance without decreasing quality too much when FSR is too expensive on a given GPU.
answers.workaround: No, but you can use a second Viewport to display 2D elements at a higher resolution while still using nearest-neighbor filtering. However, by doing so, you lose on some performance compared to using a single Viewport for everything.
